basic_info.description: Classic Doelger home in Westlake. This 3BD/2BA split-level residence offers 1,970sqft of comfortable living with all bedrooms and bathrooms on one level. The spacious living room with a fireplace opens to a dedicated dining area, while the large kitchen features painted cabinetry and an adjacent office, ideal for today's work-from-home needs. Upstairs, the primary suite is privately located at the back of the home overlooking the yard and includes a Jack-and-Jill bath with a stand-in shower and a separate soaking tub. A second bedroom is adjacent to the primary, with a third bedroom positioned at the front for added flexibility. Both bathrooms have been tastefully refinished. Original refinished parquet hardwood floors bring warmth, complemented by new luxury vinyl plank flooring in the kitchen, office, and stairs. The lower level offers a 1 car garage plus driveway parking for 2 more, abundant compartmentalized storage, washer/dryer, and an unfinished bonus room ready for expansion. Direct garage access leads to a flat backyard with new lattice fence and landscaping. Additional updates include a new roof, and new electrical main panel.  Conveniently located within walking distance to Westlake Shopping Center, a 15-min walk to BART, 15 min to SFO, and easy access to 280.
